goal: Fix GET /api/agents/:id so its recent_sessions data is scoped to the domain currently being viewed, instead of returning an agent's most-recent sessions globally across every domain and every user.
done_when: GET /api/agents/:id accepts a domainId (query param) and, when present, only includes kip_sessions whose related Dialog belongs to that domain -- sessions with no Dialog (orphans) are correctly excluded rather than surfacing as unattributed noise
The frontend call site (apps/web/src/v0/presence/presenceEnrichment.ts, the 'agent' case in fetchPresenceRecord, ~line 1305-1312) passes the domainId it already has in scope
Viewing a shared platform agent (Kip, Cloud, Rendr) from within one domain no longer surfaces another domain's session activity in its 'Recent Sessions' list
pnpm run quick:api and pnpm run quick:web pass
Manual check: viewing Kip's agent card from ke3p shows only ke3p-related sessions, not Chuck's own 'Chuck Livecchi' domain activity

touch: apps/api/src/api/agents.ts (GET /:id route, ~lines 440-467 -- add domainId query param, scope the kip_sessions include via a join on dialog.domain_id)
apps/web/src/v0/presence/presenceEnrichment.ts (the 'agent' case in fetchPresenceRecord, pass domainId as a query param)
do_not_touch: kip_sessions schema -- no domain_id column exists on it directly (confirmed: packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma:765-793), and none should be added; scope via the existing dialog relation's domain_id instead, or via kip_drafts.domain_id for sessions tied to a draft
The orphan-session creation bug itself -- that's stop-orphan-echo-sessions, a separate handoff; this one only fixes the read-side query, it doesn't stop new orphans from being created

pattern_ref: apps/api/src/api/agents.ts:449-461 currently does `prisma.kip_agents.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: { kip_sessions: { take: 5, orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' } } } })` -- no domain_id filter, no user_id filter at all. Since kip_sessions has no direct domain_id column, scope via `kip_sessions: { where: { dialog: { domain_id: domainId } }, take: 5, orderBy: { created_at: 'desc' } }` when domainId is provided -- this also naturally excludes dialog_id-null orphans, which is correct (an orphan can't be honestly attributed to any domain).

git.pr_title: fix: scope agent recent-sessions query by domain instead of returning it globally

context.phase: Sixth in today's sequence of live-testing follow-ons -- ships after chronicle-shows-document-universally.
related_handoffs: stop-orphan-echo-sessions (ships first, stops the data pollution feeding this bug)
chronicle-shows-document-universally (ships second, makes this display path less commonly hit for Dialogs specifically)
context.notes: Found by tracing Chuck's screenshot all the way to the database: GET /api/agents/:id's unscoped kip_sessions include is the exact mechanism that surfaced 'Chuck Livecchi' domain sessions while he was viewing ke3p. Confirmed with an exact file:line read of the route, not inferred. Even after chronicle-shows-document-universally ships (so a focused Dialog shows the Document instead of this view), this bug is still real and still reachable whenever a user views an agent card directly -- worth fixing on its own, not just papered over by the display fix.
